shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
horizontal band of repeated geometric pattern (zigzag/chevron in B, patterned hem-band in A)
raised arms/forelimbs bent toward the body
rows of small repeated elements forming a register
justification: Both are shallow relief on pale stone and both organise part of their field with a horizontal band of repeated pattern above or below profile figures, and each includes a small disc-like element. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a single unified scene of two elaborately detailed, anatomically modelled human figures confronting each other with fine incised texture, while B is a stacked series of schematic, blocky animal and abstract motifs on a weathered pillar with no comparable compositional logic or surface finish.
